enable_checker_only_saved.description: Turns on only calling the checker on the package being saved.

enable_checker_workspace_diagnostics.description: Turns on running all workspace diagnostics using odin check. This is currently experimental and may cause problems. A better option is using the `checker_path` feature to explicity tell `ols` the projects that it should check. (experimental).

enable_document_symbols.description: Turns on outline of all your global declarations in your document.

enable_range_format.description: Format only the declarations that the selection touches.

enable_unused_imports_reporting.description: Turn on reporting of unused imported packages.

enable_inlay_hints_params.description: Turn on inlay hints for (non-default) parameters.

enable_inlay_hints_default_params.description: Turn on inlay hints for default parameters.

enable_inlay_hints_implicit_return.description: Turn on inlay hints for implicit return values.

enable_inlay_hints_optional_result.description: Adds inlay hints for unhandled optional result value. (#optional_ok and #optional_allocator_error)

enable_procedure_snippet.description: Use snippets when completing procedures—adds parenthesis after the name.

enable_auto_import.description: Automatically import packages that aren't in your import on completion

enable_add_import_to_bottom.description: Add automatically imported packages to bottom of file

enable_references.description: Turns on finding references for a symbol.

enable_document_highlights.description: Turns on highlighting of symbol references in file.

enable_completion_matching.description: Attempt to match types and pointers when passing arguments to procedures.

enable_overload_resolution.description: Enable go-to-definition to resolve overloaded procedures from procedure groups based on call arguments.

enable_comp_lit_signature_help.description: Provide signature help for comp lits such as when instantiating structs. Will not display correctly on some editors such as vscode.

enable_comp_lit_signature_help_use_docs.description: Put signature help for comp lits in the documentation. This will allow it to be rendered nicely using markdown in editors that render the label without colour on one line.

enable_code_action_invert_if.description: Enables the code actions to invert if statements and to rewrite them as early returns.

enable_code_action_extract_variable.description: Enables the code action to extract an expression into a local variable.

enable_code_action_inline_variable.description: Enables the code action to inline a local variable into its uses.

enable_code_action_extract_procedure.description: Enables the code action to extract selected statements into a new procedure.

enable_code_action_add_explicit_type.description: Enables the code action to add the inferred type to a := declaration.

enable_code_action_ternary.description: Enables the code actions converting between an if/else and a ternary expression.

enable_code_action_unwrap.description: Enables the code actions to unwrap a block, if or loop body and to remove a redundant else.

enable_code_action_do_block.description: Enables the code actions converting a one-statement block to a `do` body and back.

enable_code_action_fill_struct.description: Enables the code action filling the missing fields of a struct literal with zero values.

enable_code_action_if_to_switch.description: Enables the code action converting an if/else-if chain of equality tests to a switch.

enable_code_action_result_handling.description: Enables the code actions adding or_return, or_else, an if on the ok/error result, or discarding the results of a call.

enable_code_action_generate_proc.description: Enables the code action generating a stub for a called procedure that does not exist.

enable_code_action_named_results.description: Enables the code action naming the results of a procedure.

enable_code_action_add_ok_result.description: Enables the code action adding a bool result to a procedure.

enable_code_action_defer_delete.description: Enables the code action adding a defer that frees an allocation.

enable_code_action_extract_constant.description: Enables the code action extracting a constant expression into a file-scope constant.

enable_code_action_inline_proc.description: Enables the code action inlining a procedure call.

enable_code_action_introduce_param.description: Enables the code action turning a constant expression into a parameter passed by every caller.

enable_code_action_remove_param.description: Enables the code action removing an unused parameter from a procedure and its callers.

enable_code_action_move_decl.description: Enables the code action moving a top-level declaration to another file of the package.

enable_code_action_generate_test.description: Enables the code action generating a @(test) stub for a procedure in the package's <file>_test.odin.

enable_code_action_comment.description: Enables the code actions adding a doc comment to the declaration at the cursor, and converting the selected comments between line and block form.

enable_code_action_literal.description: Enables the code actions converting a string literal to and from a raw string, and an integer literal between bases and digit groupings.

enable_code_action_loop_label.description: Enables the code action adding a label to the loop at the cursor.

enable_code_action_merge_cases.description: Enables the code actions to merge a switch case with the next one and to split a multi-value case.

enable_code_action_expand.description: Expand an array scalar, or_else, or_return or a range loop back to the long form.

enable_code_action_checker_fix.description: Enables quick fixes for odin check errors: dropping an unused variable and removing a cast to the same type.

enable_inlay_hints_variable_types.description: Turn on inlay hints for inferred variable types.

enable_inlay_hints_comp_lit_fields.description: Turn on inlay hints for struct field names in positional composite literals.

enable_inlay_hints_range_types.description: Turn on inlay hints for the types of range loop variables.

enable_inlay_hints_constant_values.description: Turn on inlay hints for the folded value of constant expressions.

enable_code_action_split_merge_if.description: Enables the code actions to split an if on && and to merge nested ifs.

enable_code_action_rewrite_expression.description: Enables the code actions to flip a comparison, apply De Morgan's law and convert between compound and plain assignment.

enable_organize_imports_on_save.description: Removes unused imports and adds missing ones on save through workspace/applyEdit.

struct_fields_underscore_visibility.description:
Controls visibility of struct fields starting with `_`:

- "" (default): no hiding; all fields are visible
- "file": hide fields when accessed from outside the declaring file
- "package": hide fields when accessed from outside the declaring package

enable_diagnostics.description: Enable diagnostics reported from the lsp.

verbose.description: Logs warnings instead of just errors.

odin_command.description: Specify the location to your Odin executable, rather than relying on the environment path.

odin_root_override.description: Allows you to specify a custom `ODIN_ROOT` that `ols` will use to look for `odin` core libraries when implementing custom runtimes.

enable_hover_struct_size.description: Show the byte size and alignment of a struct, and the offset and size of a struct field, on hover.

enable_checker_vet_shadowing.description: Pass `-vet-shadowing` to `odin check` and report shadowed declarations as warnings.

enable_checker_vet_unused_variables.description: Pass -vet-unused-variables to odin check. Report variables that are declared but never used.

enable_checker_vet_cast.description: Pass -vet-cast to odin check. Report casts and transmutes to a type the value already has.

enable_checker_vet_style.description: Pass -vet-style to odin check. Report style violations, such as a missing trailing comma before a closing brace on its own line.

enable_checker_vet_semicolon.description: Pass -vet-semicolon to odin check. Report unneeded semicolons.

enable_checker_vet_tabs.description: Pass -vet-tabs to odin check. Report source lines that are not indented with tabs.

enable_checker_strict_style.description: Pass -strict-style to odin check. Report style violations as hard errors; subsumes -vet-style and -vet-semicolon.

enable_lint_self_assignment.description: Warn when a variable is assigned to itself.

enable_lint_identical_branches.description: Warn when the if and else branches, or both ternary branches, are identical.

enable_lint_unreachable_code.description: Mark statements after return, break, continue, fallthrough, panic or unreachable as unnecessary.

enable_lint_simplify.description: Mark code that has a shorter equivalent (array literal with identical elements, x == true, if c { return true } else { return false }, redundant parentheses, s[0:len(s)], C-style counting loops, nested ifs, manual or_else/or_return patterns) as unnecessary and offer the rewrite as a quick fix.

enable_lint_printf.description: Check fmt and log format strings: unknown verbs, argument count, argument type, and format directives passed to the non-formatting print procedures.

enable_lint_ignored_result.description: Warn when a call statement discards a bool, union or error result that is not marked optional.

enable_lint_unused_parameter.description: Mark procedure parameters that are never used in the body as unnecessary.

enable_lint_unused_variable.description: Mark local variables and constants that are declared but never used as unnecessary.

enable_lint_naming.description: Report names that do not follow Odin conventions: snake_case procedures and variables, Ada_Case types and enum members, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constants.

enable_lint_bool_logic.description: Report boolean and comparison mistakes: identical operands, conditions that are always true or false, and if or switch branches that repeat an earlier one.

enable_lint_no_op.description: Report code that does nothing: arithmetic with an identity operand, integer division of literals that is always 0, comparing an address to nil, empty if or loop bodies, and append with no values.

enable_lint_loops.description: Report loop mistakes: a body that always exits on the first iteration, a condition nothing in the body changes, an empty infinite loop, and a range that runs one past the end.

enable_lint_dead_store.description: Report a value stored in a variable that is overwritten before anything reads it, and writes to a struct copy taken from an index, selector or range value.

enable_lint_allocator.description: Report a value allocated with an explicit allocator and freed with the context allocator, and a dynamic array made with a length that append then grows past.

enable_lint_sync.description: Report synchronisation mistakes: a lock released on the next line, a deferred lock, an atomic result assigned back to its own target, a lock passed or copied by value, and cleanup deferred before the error is checked.

enable_lint_deprecated.description: Report uses of a declaration marked with the @(deprecated) attribute.

enable_lint_core_misuse.description: Report misuses of core procedures: time.sleep with a bare integer, strings.replace with n = 0 or -1, a math rounding procedure on a converted integer, and an invalid regex pattern literal.

enable_lint_integer_range.description: Report integer range mistakes: a shift by at least the operand's bit width, an unsigned value compared against a negative literal or zero, and an integer division converted to a float afterwards.

enable_lint_recursion.description: Report a procedure whose body calls itself before any branch, loop or early return.

enable_lint_test_attribute.description: Report a procedure taking ^testing.T without an @(test) attribute, and an @(test) procedure whose signature is not proc(t: ^testing.T).

enable_lint_unused_declaration.description: On save, mark private declarations that nothing in their package references as unnecessary.

enable_lint_imports.description: Report an import repeated in the same file, and an import whose package directory does not exist.

enable_lint_invisible_characters.description: Report a string literal containing a literal zero-width, bidirectional or control character.

enable_lint_result_order.description: Report a procedure whose error-like result is followed by another result, so 'or_return' cannot be used.

enable_lint_switch.description: Report a '#partial' switch that already lists every case, and a 'break' at the end of a case.

enable_lint_call_arity.description: Report a call that passes too few or too many arguments to a resolved procedure.

enable_lint_struct_literal.description: Report a struct literal that sets the same field twice or names a field the struct does not have.

enable_lint_pure_call.description: Report a call to a core package procedure whose result is discarded.

enable_code_lens_references.description: Show a reference count above every top-level declaration.

enable_selection_range.description: Expand the selection outwards through the syntax tree.

enable_linked_editing.description: Edit every occurrence of a local variable or parameter at once.

checker_skip_packages.description: Paths to packages that should not be checked by `odin check` when using `enable_checker_workspace_diagnostics`.

completion_exclude_attributes.description: Filter procedures that include the provided attributes from completions. For example `@(test)`.

profiles.description: List of different profiles that describe the environment ols is running under.

os.description: The operating system for the profile.

checker_path.description: List of paths where to run the checker.

exclude_path.description: List of paths that will be excluded from workspace symbol searches.

defines.description: Key-value pairs of defines. Used for evaluating when expressions, for example `ODIN_DEBUG`. The value must be a string.
